The '''GRGC-800''' was a model of [[gravity treadmill]] produced by the company [[Quarlitech Aergronics, Inc.]] that could simulate both high and low [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] environments. The treadmill was circular in shape with a railing around one side and was advertised for use in the privacy of one's own home. Dedicated training on the device over a period of between a few [[Standard day/Legends|days]] and a few [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], with the amount of [[Time/Legends|time]] depending on the difference between the simulated gravity and what the user was accustomed to, allowed users to acclimate to the gravity strengths that they practiced in.<ref name="Fantastic Technology" /> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Fantastic Technology Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' places its timeframe between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] respectively.</ref> the company [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]] sold GRGC-800s through its [[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology|product catalog]] for 700 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The equipment was also frequently available in large [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]<ref name="Fantastic Technology" /> during the same [[Imperial Era/Legends|time period]].<ref name="Fantastic Technology Date" />

==Behind the scenes==
The GRGC-800 was mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook written by [[Rick D. Stuart]] and released by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]].<ref name="Fantastic Technology" />
